description: This file contains React hooks and utility functions for managing channel bookmarks in the Mattermost web application, including permission checks, fetching, reordering, and emoji handling.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Generates a permission key string based on action and channel type.

methods.name: useChannelBookmarkPermission
methods.description: React hook to check if the user has permission for a specific bookmark action in a channel.

methods.name: getHaveIChannelBookmarkPermission
methods.description: Checks if the current user has specific bookmark permissions for a given channel.

methods.name: useCanUploadFiles
methods.description: React hook to determine if the user can upload files.

methods.name: useCanGetPublicLink
methods.description: React hook to determine if public links are enabled.

methods.name: useCanGetLinkPreviews
methods.description: React hook to determine if link previews are enabled.

methods.name: getIsChannelBookmarksEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the channel bookmarks feature is enabled and licensed.

methods.name: useChannelBookmarks
methods.description: React hook to manage channel bookmarks, including fetching, ordering, and reordering.
